My cards came today :D.

I had a look at them - unfortunately the errata cards for Fanatic, Ra, and Tachyon are noticeably smaller than the rest of their decks, so I'll jsut continue to use the old cards as I know to remember the errata'd rules anyway.

I had a look at Spite and am thinking he might be...interesting. I'll have to try him out in an actual game, though, as just by reading his card it looks a lot more complicated than I expect it is - I find this stuff easier to understand if I can actually "act it out" rather than just read it.

Had alook at Gloomweaver's front side and thought "Hmm, okay that doesn't look too bad", then turned him over and went "Oh. Maybe not", lol. Looking foward to fighting both these new guys, as well as trying out the promos for Expatriette, Mr Fixer, and Nightmist. Obviously Setback's gonna have to wait.
